Duration: 9sec Pushes up to 5 enemies within 10m away from the caster, and pulls 5 raid members closer. Decreases pulled raid members' received damage -50% and increases your Mettle +1500. Effective regardless of a target's status. Affected allies and enemies are Staggered, briefly stopping movement and canceling all Cast Time and Channeled skills. This skill counts as a Push effect. Defense Shield Throw (Rank 2) Abyssal Charges 2 Range: 0-10 m Melee Attack +100% Cast Time 0.5sec 22sec Cooldown Effect Granted Disarmed Temporarily lose all benefits from your primary weapon. Duration: 6sec Hurls your shield at the target, dealing (540 + 100% Melee Attack) Physical Damage. Has a 100% chance to Critical Strike. Temporarily removes all benefits of your shield while the projectile is in the air. Inflicts Disarm on targets that Parry the attack, removing all benefits of their weapon for 6sec. Bounces on impact, striking up to 3 additional nearby targets. Adds 2 Abyssal Charges when a skill that increases charges is used. Charges do not decrease naturally. Duration: 6sec Increases maximum Abyssal Charges +2 for 12 seconds. Prevents charges from naturally depleting for the duration, and doubles charges gained through using skills. Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration. Duration: 4sec Tethers an enemy's soul to a location for 4sec, pulling them back to that spot every time they attempt to move further than 10m away. Any additional Abyssal Charges are consumed on casting, increasing the duration. Passive Passive Skill Supplemental Block Increases Block Rate +15% for 5 seconds after a successful Block. This ability has a 12 sec cooldown once triggered. Unlocks once 4 skill points are spent in Defense. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Shield of Steel Increases Physical Defense +6%. Unlocks once 6 skill points are spent in Defense. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Guardian Permanently increases Aggro generation +50%. Unlocks once 7 skill points are spent in Defense. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Spry Fortress Decreases Stun and Tripped duration -10%. Unlocks once 8 skill points are spent in Defense. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Bear's Vigor Increases max health +900. Increases the effectiveness of Refreshment +20% and Toughen +33%. Unlocks once 9 skill points are spent in Defense. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Ursine Roar Decreases the cooldown of Defense skills -20%. Increases Continuous Health Regen based on Stamina whenever damage is received while below 30% health. Unlocks once 10 skill points are spent in Defense. Learning it costs 1 skill point. Passive Skill Indomitable Rage Shield Slam, Bull Rush, Revitalizing Cheer, Mocking Howl, and Boastful Roar each grant 1 Abyssal Charge whenever they're used. Cannot be upgraded further. Ollo Defenders of Erenor look to Ollo, the son of a dwarven king whose land was conquered in battle. A greedy seeker obsessed with time manipulation, he would later become Shatigon, the god of gold and abundance. Defense is the tank skill tree. It builds Mettle from the damage you take and spends it on healing and on aggro, and it keeps enemies on you with taunts, stuns and a silence. It deals little damage of its own, so it is usually paired with trees that bring damage and utility or further crowd control. Ollo

Defenders of Erenor look to Ollo, the son of a dwarven king whose land was conquered in battle. A greedy seeker obsessed with time manipulation, he would later become Shatigon, the god of gold and abundance.

Defense is the tank skill tree. It builds Mettle from the damage you take and spends it on healing and on aggro, and it keeps enemies on you with taunts, stuns and a silence. It deals little damage of its own, so it is usually paired with trees that bring damage and utility or further crowd control.
